verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait original shrunk into the centre of a wide canvas. It leaves big blank side bands, never adapts to the banner shape, and the body copy and vertical URL become tiny, but the design is intact and coherent. B tries to rearrange the layout and breaks it: the diamond collage is cropped into a ragged block with a stray vertical photo strip, the divider rule drifts off to the left away from the headline, the headline and body sit on a different axis from the collage, and the URL floats alone in a large empty right half.
